summary: Plus Automation, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its Agreement and Plan of Merger with Churchill Capital Corp IX, a SPAC, effective April 20, 2026. The merger was terminated by mutual consent due to market conditions. No termination fee or other terms were disclosed. The filing is under Item 1.02 (Termination of a Material Definitive Agreement). This represents a mutual walk-away from a de-SPAC business combination. What to watch: whether Churchill seeks another target or PlusAI pursues an alternative liquidity event; the absence of a break fee suggests an amicable split with no penalty.
